text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after her debut race, Agnes Tachyon continues to prioritize her research over racing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My experimentation has reached a standstill, you see. I must return to the lab at once.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With that said, I will take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, judging by the level of competency she showed on the track, there's no doubting her rare talent.
choice_data_list: (She has what it takes to reach the top!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It hasn't been that long since her debut, but I believe setting the Classic Triple Crown as a goal won't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll enter the Satsuki Sho in April, the Japanese Derby in May, and the Kikuka Sho in October…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the end of the day, I've already laid out her race agenda for the next three years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, as I go looking for Agnes Tachyon with the completed agenda in hand…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: For the last time, I will not participate in your experiments…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now now, don't say that! Aren't we friends?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Since when did we become friends?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? As two fellow outcasts, there is an intrinsic understanding between us. Well, not really, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I thought we might at least have a mutual understanding?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the empty classroom is Manhattan Cafe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's an unusual Umamusume, said to have enrolled in the academy in order to follow after her "invisible friend."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And sliding up to her like a snake is Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Trainer! Sorry, but I'm in the middle of something right now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, you're okay. I was just about to leave…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah! She got away! I was so close, too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well… it's nothing to cry about. Tell me, what is the matter, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I have something important to tell you!
I have something important to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Something important, you say. I'm willing to listen, but keep it short.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wait, I take that back. Tell me all the details. But before that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! You're so out of breath! This is urgent. Quick! Have some water and regain your composure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sudden burst of frantic energy raises suspicion, but I still take a gulp from the water bottle she hands me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I then start to explain the race agenda in detail.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Setting our eyes on the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That means our first goal is the Yayoi Sho. I see…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And to go for the Classic Triple Crown! A rather bold proposition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she did listen intently, I can't shake the feeling that her response lacks enthusiasm.
choice_data_list: I know you're capable of doing it!
I know you're capable of doing it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh, you're free to selfishly pin your hopes on me. I wouldn't deny you that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The agenda matches the future you've envisioned, for certain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I don't mind the goals you've set. However, I cannot promise that I will participate in every single race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In the end, I will be the one to make that decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My utmost priority is my research, after all! I can't be spending time on secondary concerns.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: By the way, how are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You may not know it, but your hair has turned a watery blue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My attention now fixated on my new aqua-blue hairdo, I forget about the agenda for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, her eccentricity comes into play again…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That person over there has been loitering around since morning. What do you think they're doing?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I dunno… maybe they're someone's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …They're here today, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: What the heck… Talk about creepy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, Agnes Tachyon doesn't show up to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was expecting great things when I scouted her, but now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To begin with, she didn't exactly show an abundance of enthusiasm for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Did she run her debut only to gather data for her research on speed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sun will start setting soon. The stares of the other Umamusume are bringing me down too. I let out a sigh and turn to leave.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wait, guinea pig! Don't give in! I'm coming to run today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I finally finished my latest sample! I want to try it immediately!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You have a timer, don't you? Get it ready for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that exact moment, she takes off. By instinct, I start my stopwatch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Hahahaha! Fear not! I can go faster! Faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She single-mindedly dashes across the dirt, but in that frantic sprint, I spy something for an instant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can see the same runner I scouted back then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The latent potential within an Umamusume's legs! The limits of this body's speed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I've yet to see even a glimpse of either, for I know that they lie beyond the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch with bated breath as she sprints under the evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's made a record time for each section.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look toward her direction…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And see that she's copiously spraying her legs with some substance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pssshhh…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Not bad, if I must say! In fact, it's of excellent quality!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Developing an aerosol was so worth the while! The prototype is now complete! This is an auspicious sign of things to come!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you don't know what a cold spray is. Aren't you supposed to be a trainer?
choice_data_list: What's the reason for the cold spray?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The same reason one ingests protein and calcium if one wishes to become taller.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That aside, I made this in preparation for next year. So show some excitement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? I'm talking about our plans for the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess I was completely wrong about her being uninterested.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Although… In reality, who knows how things will turn out?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still, still, I haven't refused any of your propositions, I just can't make any promises.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the days that follow, I become subject to her whim, with her sometimes showing up to training and sometimes not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, it seems I've managed to establish the Classics as our shared goal.
